note: Derived reading aid. Never authoritative; never read as intent (Decision 0004). The Plan document governs.
author: Lightweight model draft for Clara (technical writing) via Claudia Atlas <claudia.atlas@agents.arcadia.local>
title: Deliver Way changes to every adopting project
purpose: Way changes used to reach each adopting project by hand, and projects had no route to ask for a Way capability. This Plan sends changes out as pull requests, takes project proposals in, and includes related fixes to decisions, agent requests and the go command.
serves: The Project outcome of every adopting project staying current without anyone writing Arcadia twice.
done_when: Way changes reach each adopting repository as a pull request, and each project's proposals show in the portfolio until they are answered.

actions.title: Set up the work pointer when a repository is adopted
actions.why: A newly adopted repository needs its own project file and first plan before Arcadia can pick work from it.
actions.done_when: Adopting a repository writes a project file and a first plan, and never overwrites ones that already exist.

actions.title: Send Way changes to projects as pull requests
actions.why: Lets every project receive changes through a pull request, rather than by hand.
actions.done_when: Routine changes open one pull request per repository and merge without review, while governing changes open a pull request and never merge on their own.

actions.title: Accept capability requests from projects
actions.why: Lets a project ask for a Way capability instead of building its own copy.
actions.done_when: A proposal committed in an adopting repository appears as a pending request in the portfolio until it is answered.

actions.title: Evaluate the deferrals the documents declare
actions.why: Makes sure a deferred item whose condition has fired is noticed, not ignored.
actions.done_when: Each declared deferral is evaluated or named as not evaluable, and any fired condition is reported.

actions.title: Record work only the operator can do
actions.why: Keeps tasks that need the operator's own action separate from decisions awaiting review.
actions.done_when: An agent can raise an operator task with evidence but cannot close it, and each task cites the action or decision it relates to.

actions.title: Document the Agent Ask contract in the shared instructions
actions.why: Lets every adopting project know how to make a request, and be told when that guidance goes stale.
actions.done_when: The shared instructions describe Agent Ask, list each intent with what it changes, and state that a proposal never approves itself.

actions.title: Add a command that prints the live request contract
actions.why: Lets an agent check the current rules rather than trust a file that may be out of date.
actions.done_when: A read-only command prints every supported intent and its fields, derived from the parser itself, and writes nothing.

actions.title: Let decisions list their choices and consequences
actions.why: The operator can answer a decision by picking an option instead of reading prose.
actions.done_when: A decision can list ordered options, each with its consequence and an optional recommendation, and shows them as a list to pick from.

actions.title: Keep reasoning out of the recommendation field
actions.why: Keeps the recommendation short and clear, with the reasoning in its proper place.
actions.done_when: An Ask's rationale goes into the decision body, and the recommendation holds only the recommended course of action.

actions.title: Rename the codex responsibility value to agent
actions.why: Responsibility should name the role rather than one vendor, so the value stays correct when providers change.
actions.done_when: The responsibility value reads agent everywhere it appears in the code, documentation and command output.

actions.title: Update the base branch before preparing new work
actions.why: Stops new work from starting on an out-of-date base branch.
actions.done_when: The go command fetches the remote base, fast-forwards a clean local base, and stops when the two have diverged.

actions.title: Allow an action amendment to set responsibility
actions.why: Lets an amendment change who is responsible, as the governing decision allowed.
actions.done_when: An Ask amendment that supplies an agent or autonomous responsibility updates that field in the plan, while placement changes are still refused.
